source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Qualify with a quiz
People love to talk about themselves. So, let ‘em. Quiz ‘em, tag ‘em, and send the right offer at the right time
Business value
Stop guessing who’s hot or not. Segment your admirers from your buyers. Build profiles. Qualify folks for your next big launch — without ever leaving Facebook.
How does it work?
Someone sends you a keyword. You hit back with a few fun, strategic questions. Their answers sort them into your funnels like magic.
